review.notes: Coverage partial. Line-by-line: title block, author byline and affiliation footnote on physical pages 1-2 (p.2 rendered twice at 300 dpi and the first footnote line at 600 dpi; author list cross-checked against the PDF text layer through the final byline entry "Zipeng Lin 34", which the OCR transcribes completely). Pages 3-4 flagged text is figure-internal (dataset/robot statistics chart labels and the architecture diagram, both inside embedded figures); pages 8-9 flagged text is reference page ranges ("pp 13 778 13 790" = "pp. 13,778-13,790" printed with comma/en-dash), a tokenization artifact rather than droppage; pages 5-7 and 10-12 stayed above the flag threshold. The arXiv sidebar stamp on p.1 is not a defect. Lower-confidence observations left unchanged: the final byline entry ends "Zipeng Lin\(^ { 34 }" without the closing math delimiter that earlier entries carry, but the exported reader tokenizes the byline markers into annotations, so the line was not mechanically rewritten; the collaboration marker superscripts "0" and "1" print fused before "Allen Institute for AI" and are transcribed as $^{01}$ to match the print.
